mapper.select: SELECT block.id AS block_id, block.table_id AS block_table_id, block.title AS block_title, block.status, block.width, block.start_at, block.color, task.title AS task_title, schedule.id AS schedule_id, schedule.kind, schedule.start_at, schedule.end_at, schedule.start_date, schedule.end_date, schedule.title AS schedule_title FROM time_blocks block LEFT JOIN time_block_tasks task ON block.id = task.time_block_id LEFT JOIN schedule schedule ON block.schedule_id = schedule.id WHERE block_id = #{id}
